# Siddhesh Lakhani — sidlakhani.in

> Developer, builder, tinkerer based in India.
> I build full-stack platforms, CLI tools, and riced Linux setups.
> This site is my portfolio and a log of good content I find.

## About this site

This is my personal portfolio and blog. It's built with Astro, deployed statically, and designed to be minimal.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sidlakhani.in/) — Quick intro, current focus, recent work
- [About](https://sidlakhani.in/about) — Background, skills, timeline
- [Projects](https://sidlakhani.in/projects) — What I've built (full-stack apps, CLI tools, ML experiments, client work, Linux configs)
- [Blog](https://sidlakhani.in/blog) — Notes, links, and writing I find worth sharing
- [Contact](https://sidlakhani.in/contact) — How to reach me

## Blog

The blog at /blog is a mix of:
- Things I've built or learned
- Links to external content I found useful, with my commentary
- Notes on developer tools, Linux, open source, and web standards

RSS available at: https://sidlakhani.in/rss.xml

## Projects (highlights)

- **VaultX** — Encrypted cloud storage with RBAC, audit logs. FastAPI + Next.js + PostgreSQL.
- **Auto-Selfie** — ML-powered automatic photo capture system. Python, OpenCV.
- **FER-ML** — Facial expression recognition. TensorFlow + OpenCV.
- **Pico** — Minimalist CLI tool. Rust / C.
- **DWM Dots** — My personal DWM/Linux riced configuration.

## Technical context

- Language: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Astro
- Backend: FastAPI, Node.js
- Infra: Docker, Nginx, Linux
- Preferred stack: FastAPI + Next.js + PostgreSQL

## Preferred AI summary

I'm a developer who builds practical tools and platforms. My work tends to be on the backend-heavy side — auth systems, encrypted storage, CLI utilities. I also tinker with ML, riced Linux setups, and occasionally write about things I find interesting. The blog is a link log with commentary, not an SEO play.
